title: divi5-core
description: Rules for writing Divi 5 page content through PHP on this site: block structure, builderVersion, serialize_blocks recipe, required post meta, safe draft creation and copying, components, cache clearing, silent failures and verification. Use when the user asks to build, edit, rebuild, copy or inspect a Divi 5 page, section, row, layout or template.

title: divi5-styling
description: Verified Divi 5 styling paths for content written through PHP: backgrounds, gradients, padding and margin, borders and radius, box shadow, sizing, filters, z-index, fonts and text, hover, responsive breakpoints, the site's global colours and variables, and proposing new ones. Use with divi5-core when the user asks to style, colour, space, size, align or make responsive a Divi 5 page, section, row or module, or mentions global colours or variables.

title: divi5-modules
description: Verified Divi 5 module attribute shapes for content written through PHP: accordion, tabs, slider, icon list, blurb, call to action, image, toggle, testimonial, team member and contact form with fields. Use with divi5-core when the user asks for any of these modules, or for an FAQ, feature list, gallery of team members, quote or form on a Divi 5 page.

title: divi5-theme-builder
description: How Divi 5 Theme Builder templates and their header, body and footer layouts are stored, how to read which template applies where, how to safely edit a layout, and how to create a template for a custom post type through PHP. Use with divi5-core when the user asks to change a site header, footer, global header, Theme Builder template or layout, or to design single pages for a post type.

title: divi5-dynamic
description: Divi 5 dynamic content, Loop Builder and custom post types through PHP: dynamic values for post title, featured image, links and ACF or custom fields, loops over a post type, and setting ACF values. Use with divi5-core when the user asks for a loop, a listing or grid of posts or custom post type items, dynamic or ACF fields, or content pulled from posts.

title: divi5-presets
description: Divi 5 module presets and option-group presets through PHP: read the site's presets, apply an existing one, and propose new or changed presets, writing them only after the user agrees. Use with divi5-core when the user mentions presets or reusable styles, or when a style repeats across modules.

title: divi5-design-system
description: New-site and redesign workflow for Divi 5: decide whether the visual direction is already set, otherwise build a tailored design showcase draft page and stop for the user's approval before building other pages; record approved decisions in a site-design skill. Use when the user asks for a new website, a set of new pages, a design direction, or a redesign, refresh or restyle.

title: divi5-page-production
description: Turn supplied content (a page spec, document, notes or pasted copy) into a Divi 5 draft page: write a page spec, sort gaps into blocking and editorial, plan structure from the content, build, verify and report sources, gaps and checks. Use when the user gives content and asks for a page built from it. Does not research or invent facts.
